# Pitlane 0.5.4

A clearer path from your purchase to your first message with Maestro.

- Download Pitlane directly from the purchase confirmation page.
- Receive confirmation and welcome emails with the instructions to access your account. New accounts use a temporary password and choose their own password before authorizing the app.
- Connect your AI accounts before choosing a project. Pitlane recognizes supported accounts already connected on your computer and guides new connections through the provider's supported sign-in.
- Choose an existing folder or create a new project. Pitlane asks before preparing a folder for version control and preserves your files.
- Return to your project after reopening or authorizing Pitlane again. Manage additional AI accounts from Settings → Agents.
- A consistent white, black and green interface across the desktop app and account pages, with improved text contrast.

Windows x64. Claude Code and Codex use supported account access. Gemini requires an API key or an eligible work account. Grok and OpenRouter are shown as upcoming connections and are not enabled in this release.

Your AI usage stays with the account you connect. API usage may have separate costs.
